units.unit_description: This unit is a solid oxide electrolyzer operating at about 800 °C. At its reference size it produces 1 kg/h of hydrogen from 10.78 kg/h of water, of which 1.84 kg/h are recovered, with 34.217 kW of electricity. A sweep air of 55.66 kg/h carries away the oxygen produced.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes water and electricity, and delivers hydrogen and oxygen-enriched air. The sweep air is drawn from the atmosphere and is not given as a connector.

connectors.description: Sweep air enriched with the oxygen produced, 30 % O2 (molar)

units.heat_streams_description: The sweep air and the feed water are heated to the stack temperature, and the enriched air and the hydrogen leaving the stack are cooled to 25 °C.
